blocks.content: Post-audit feature backlog, ordered by value-to-effort within four tracks: Security & robustness (macOS Seatbelt sandbox for run_command, worker-thread tools, approval-card risk annotations, orphaned-backup recovery), Agent capability (Ollama model manager, per-turn snapshot & rollback, per-server MCP env vars, project-defined slash commands), UX (drag-drop file context, timeline virtualization, chat branching, PDF export via the bundled doc-pdf plugin), and Platform (R12 native Windows/Linux verification, signed auto-update channel later).
Quick wins first, then the sandboxing and snapshot tracks in parallel with model management and platform verification.
